drugs.name: Resmetirom
drugs.mechanism: Liver-directed selective thyroid hormone receptor-beta (THR-beta) agonist promoting mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation and lipophagy
drugs.efficacy: First FDA-approved therapy resolving NASH and reducing liver fibrosis in non-cirrhotic MASH
drugs.adverse_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, pruritus, abdominal pain, vomiting

drugs.name: Semaglutide
drugs.mechanism: GLP-1 receptor agonist reducing hepatic steatosis, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing systemic inflammation
drugs.approval: FDA Approved (for T2D/Obesity, Phase 3 in MASH)
drugs.efficacy: High rate of NASH resolution without worsening of liver fibrosis
drugs.adverse_effects: Nausea, constipation, diarrhea, vomiting, decreased appetite

drugs.name: Pioglitazone
drugs.mechanism: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARG) agonist enhancing adiponectin and hepatic insulin sensitivity
drugs.approval: FDA Approved (for T2D, Guideline supported in NASH)
drugs.efficacy: Improves steatohepatitis histology and glycemic control in patients with NASH
drugs.adverse_effects: Weight gain, peripheral edema, risk of heart failure exacerbation, bone fractures

drugs.name: Lanifibranor
drugs.mechanism: Pan-PPAR agonist simultaneously addressing metabolism, inflammation, and fibrosis pathways
drugs.efficacy: Statistically significant NASH resolution and fibrosis improvement in phase 2b trial
drugs.adverse_effects: Mild weight gain, peripheral edema, nausea, fatigue
